# ReedShield

> ReedShield is an AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) platform. It discovers AI
> agents, models, APIs, data sources, non-human identities and the cloud
> infrastructure AI runs on, then continuously scores risk, enforces policy and
> prioritizes remediation.

## What ReedShield does

- AI asset discovery: inventory every model, agent, LLM app, tool, API and data source.
- AI model & agent security: scan artefacts and govern autonomous agents at runtime.
- Cloud, data and identity security: correlate AI risk with the posture around it.
- Runtime security: inspect prompts, responses, tool calls and policy decisions live.
- Attack paths: chain findings (exposed secret to over-privileged role to exposed data).
- Governance & compliance: map controls to frameworks and score them from live evidence.

## Compliance frameworks (control mapping, not certification)

- DPDP Act 2023, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001, OWASP LLM Top 10,
  HIPAA, RBI, IRDAI, SEBI CSCRF, CERT-In, EU AI Act.

## Key pages

- Home: https://reedshield.io/home
- Get started: https://reedshield.io/get-started

## Notes

- Control mapping indicates coverage, not accredited certification.
- The authenticated product (/admin) is not part of the public site.
